items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XIII, List of Answers on Terminology 84:1
items.html: At the time when Arich Anpin ascends to the HBD of Atik, where it receives the coupling in the stature of Atik, which is the aspect of the revealed AB, without the correction of the MEM in its first three — then the returning surrounding light enters the internality of the Mochin, and with it also the hairs of the head and the beard. Then the hairs too become inner vessels, that is, ten inner Sefirot, as written above on Page 302, Item 12, see there. And then they have ten Sefirot from Keter and ten Sefirot from Hochma. And the ten Sefirot of Keter return to be above, and the ten Sefirot of Hochma return to be below — that is, the coarser is higher. (Page 391, Item 196).
